info.title: SSL Certificate Expiry Check API
info.description: Inspects a hostname's TLS certificate and returns its issuer, subject, expiry date and days remaining. Pre-launch design; endpoints are not live yet.

x-planned-pricing.model: free tier for evaluation, paid tiers by volume

servers.description: Pre-launch: endpoints are not live yet and answer 503.

get.description: Returns the TLS certificate served for a hostname, including its issuer, subject, expiry date and days remaining.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: The hostname to inspect for its TLS certificate.

404.description: No certificate found or the hostname did not resolve.

503.description: Pre-launch: endpoints are not live yet.
